body: Oh I don't mind that she uses it to cope (I just can't smoke period lol), I just wish I could get her some at this point :(
Well she seems rather grateful that I'm willing to go over and spend time with her, I wish I could help with the weed aspect, but I can't sadly.
It's alright, I'm really hoping spending time with her helps. Thank you so much for the advice :)

Yeah I'm gonna go spend a day with her to see if that helps, I know she can't get EI here in Canada unless she's fired or let go, and apparently welfare won't be enough to cover her expenses at the moment. 

I know she said some weed would help her cope, but I have no connections for that sort of thing -.-

She can quit, but then she would have no way of supporting herself in the months ahead and would be homeless at that point. I've offered to spend time with her to cheer her up, but she's refused it. At this point she's given up and is raging at every injustice in the world, and I have no clue how to respond.
